request.style: English, male smooth jazz voice, upright bass, piano, brushed drums, saxophone, warm and reverent mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In the fifteenth year of Tiberius
Pontius Pilate ruled the land
Herod tetrarch in Galilee
Philip ruled across the land
Ituraea and Trachonitis
Lysanias held Abilene
History set the stage in time
For what would come to be

[Chorus]
Who do people say that I am
John the Baptist some declare
Others whisper it is Elijah
Jeremiah or a prophet there
But who do you say that I am
Simon Peter stood up to say
You are the Christ the Son
Of the living God today

[Verse]
Jesus came to Caesarea Philippi
Into the region near the sea
He asked the disciples who they know
What the crowds were saying free
They listed names of ancient seers
Prophets long ago had died
But the question turned to them alone
To let the truth inside

[Chorus]
Who do people say that I am
John the Baptist some declare
Others whisper it is Elijah
Jeremiah or a prophet there
But who do you say that I am
Simon Peter stood up to say
You are the Christ the Son
Of the living God today

[Bridge]
In the villages around the city
Teaching on the way to go
The disciples walked with Jesus
In Philip's tetrarchy's glow
The question echoes through the ages
Who is the Son of Man
Peter's answer stands as witness
The Messiah of all lands

[Outro]
You are the Christ the Son
Of the living God
